decisions.reason: As a digitally oriented offering far from the firm’s display-focused core and only lightly featured on the website, it is the most likely to fall below aspiration levels and be discontinued so resources can return to core customer solutions or development work.

Because it builds on the established display business and supports the firm’s move toward broader cardboard solutions, management would likely tolerate some early uncertainty and keep it unless results clearly disappoint.
This quarter-pallet pegboard display is very close to the firm’s proven capabilities and was given its own webpage, suggesting acceptable early traction relative to aspiration levels.
A small counter display is highly aligned with the firm’s narrow core offer and operational strengths, so it is likely to be retained as a standard extension of the existing business.

Although somewhat more niche, the large freestanding information display still fits the firm’s core display competence and dedicated web presentation indicates enough promise to keep it on the market.
